items.title: 메디웨일, 망막 기반 심혈관 위험 예측 AI '닥터눈 CVD' 미국 FDA 510(k) 허가
items.excerpt: 메디웨일의 망막 사진 기반 AI '닥터눈 CVD'가 FDA 510(k) 허가를 받았다. 안저 사진으로 10년 내 첫 죽상경화성 심혈관질환(ASCVD) 발생 위험을 추정해 위험 점수와 3단계 위험군을 제시하며, 회사는 미국 1차 의료기관 보급을 추진한다.
items.rationale: Regulatory milestone: a Korean retinal-imaging CVD risk AI cleared by FDA 510(k), aimed at US primary care.

items.title: Rapid comparative evaluation of 2 ambient artificial intelligence applications in a learning health system
items.source: JAMIA (Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association)
items.excerpt: A learning-health-system evaluation compared two ambient AI scribes (Abridge and Nabla) among 100 providers over 90 days using a cluster randomized crossover design plus EHR workflow outcomes and simulated encounters, measuring satisfaction, efficiency, documentation quality, usability and patient sentiment.
items.rationale: Rare head-to-head randomized crossover of two commercial ambient scribes; directly useful for health systems choosing a vendor.

items.title: Predictive uncertainty representations in clinical AI shape physicians' advice uptake, accuracy, and trust
items.excerpt: 227 physicians assessed patient cases with an AI risk estimate shown with or without representations of the model's predictive uncertainty; how uncertainty was displayed changed how often doctors took the AI's advice, their accuracy and their trust.
items.rationale: Experimental evidence that how a clinical AI displays uncertainty changes physician uptake and accuracy; patient-safety and interface-design angle.

items.title: How artificial intelligence is offering new hope for stroke patients in the Last Frontier
items.excerpt: In Alaska, a small network of hospitals is betting on AI tools to triage stroke patients and get them to the right care faster across vast distances.
items.rationale: Real-world hospital deployment story: AI stroke triage across a remote, sparse care network; distinct from the 11-23 RSNA outcomes study.

items.title: FDA Clears Emerging AI Triage Software for Nine Findings on Abdominopelvic CT
items.excerpt: FDA cleared a2z Radiology's a2z-Omni-Triage, AI software for adjunctive triage of nine acute findings on abdominopelvic CT.
items.rationale: FDA clearance of a multi-finding (nine acute findings) abdominal CT triage tool, broader than the single-finding triage products seen so far.
